_comment: Example input for scripts/build_schedule_page.py — a curated, approved schedule (not the raw recommend output). Built from the Ada Lovelace demo profile in profile-example.json, real events from the bundled dataset. Copy the shape, not the specifics. Only a first name goes on the page — no last name, company, title, or RSVP mechanics. Give each day a "date" (YYYY-MM-DD) so the week strip at the top can highlight and jump-link to it. "why" lines are neutral/informative, not second-person advice — this page gets shared publicly.

events.name: ur +1 is a stranger #sftechweek
events.neighborhood: Runs all week, no fixed venue
events.why: A week-long matchmaking layer — everyone gets introduced to one person worth meeting at whatever event they're already at.

events.name: Voice AI in the Wild — Demos & Lunch with Vonage + Deepgram
events.why: Deepgram and Vonage demoing production voice AI over lunch — a good look at where the infra is heading.

events.name: Meet SF's Early-Stage Founders and Investors
events.why: Three seed funds hosting founders and investors in one room — one of the bigger fundraising mixers of the week.

events.name: Apollo: Find Your Next 100 Customers
events.why: A GTM-and-buyers crowd — good exposure for an early enterprise pitch before real prospect calls.

events.name: How Great Companies Hire the Best Talent — The Hiring Factory
events.why: Recruiters and hiring leads talking through what it actually takes to land strong early hires.

events.name: CxO Roundtable: How Enterprise Really Buys AI
events.why: Small-format conversation with enterprise buyers on how AI actually gets adopted internally — not a mixer.

events.name: AI & Platform Engineering Developer Meetup
events.why: An engineer-dense evening on agentic product development and evals.
